table.name: TLGNC_MAT_COMPAT
table.description: Material compatibility for left-behind materials in a returning wagon and material to-be-loaded next, also known as 'Product Change Matrix'. Two percentage levels are defined for such a material: If the left-behind amount is below the 1st threshold, the material is considered compatible with ALL other materials and can be filled with any other material. If the left-behind amount is higher than the 2nd threshold, only the IDENTICAL material is allowed. The special case is when the amount lies between the thresholds: Any material which is explicitely defined in tlgnc_mat_compat_mat can be loaded then. These rules are used when loading a wagon at a railway shippingpoint, but they could be used similarly also for truck loading etc.

column.name: FROM_SAP_MATERIAL_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_material. The left-behind material in the wagon/truck/... from the last load. Note: Just the material number; the rules are expressed independent of production plant.

column.name: INSIGNIFICANT_THRESHOLD_PERC
column.description: The lower threshold of a product compatibility entry. If the ratio of (remain_net_load : planned_total_net_load)*100 is LESS than this value, any material from any production plant can be loaded. This does not mean that the wagon/truck counts as empty though: Credit notes can still be issued, and the remaining quantity must also be respected when calculating the net amount to load.

column.name: FORCE_IDENTICAL_THRESHOLD_PERC
column.description: The upper threshold of a product compatibility entry. If the ratio of (remain_net_load : planned_total_net_load)*100 is GREATER than this value, only identical material (from_sap_material_id) AND same production plant can be loaded. If the ratio lies between these two thresholds, only 'compatible' materials (from any plant, as listed in tlgnc_mat_compat_mat) can be loaded for this material.

column.name: COMPAT_COMMENT
column.description: A comment which expresses the general aspects for the from-material and the threshold values of this compatibility rule.

column.name: INCOMPAT_COMMENT
column.description: A comment which describes why other materials are NOT ok to be mixed within the threshold values defined by this compatibility rule.
